name: Sakakibara Rio
source: A girl who is the same age as [url=/c44220]Yuuma[/url] but in a different class. She is either always sleeping or feeling very sleepy, and she tends to fall asleep in the weirdest places, with the school's emergency exit staircase being among her favorites. Despite it all, it is rumored that she is somehow able to stay awake during classes.
